description: DESTRUCTIVE: Permanently delete a model from one provider. provider is REQUIRED (no fan-out). If the client supports elicitation the user is asked to confirm directly; otherwise confirm:true is required.

confirm.description: Must be true when the client cannot ask the user directly (no elicitation support)

provider.description: Provider to delete from (required). Omit to let the server choose (local providers only, unless LOCAL_AI_ALLOW_HOSTED_FALLBACK is set).
